about: RunningRecs starter catalog (2026-10-21): running shoes from 12 brands, the two newest versions of each line that RunRepeat lists (releases before 2023, Gore-Tex and wide editions left out). Weight (men's), heel and forefoot stack height and drop are the brands' published figures as listed on each shoe's RunRepeat page, linked in sources. Category comes from RunRepeat's terrain, arch support and pace: trail, stability, racing (competition), tempo, max cushion (heel stack 38 mm or more) or daily trainer. Plate is left blank until checked. Columns: shape = category, balance = stack height, core = drop, surface = plate.
